disease_name: Conjunctivitis in newborns and pneumonia in children
indication: treatment of acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis
uncomplicated infections of the skin and subcutaneous tissue
eradication of Helicobacter Pylori in combination with Amoxicillin and proton pump inhibitors
pharmaceutical_form: tablet || granules used to prepare syrup || extended release tablet
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: children 15mg/kg daily (divided into at least two equal doses)
reduced by at least 50% in patients with impaired renal function
mechanism_of_action: inhibits the synthesis of proteins in the bacterial cell, leading to the absence of major proteins and abruption of normal cellular functions
side_effects: dizziness, vertigo, confusion and disorientation || dizziness, fainting, palpitations, and arrhythmias || liver damage or a serious muscle disorder called rhabdomyolysis
unsuitable_population: patients who are allergic to Clarithromycin or other macrolide antibiotics, patients with low levels of potassium in the blood (hypokalaemia), impaired liver function, kidney damage, or cardiac problems
